releaseNotes:
• Default Light Theme: Fresh, modern, high-contrast light theme enabled as the out-of-the-box default across the entire app
• User Theme Switcher: Switch anytime between Light (Default), Dark, and System Default themes in the App Settings dialog
• Dynamic Editor Theming: Sora code editor automatically adapts syntax highlighting and gutter colors dynamically to the active theme
• Quick Settings Access: Dedicated Settings button in the TopAppBar and persistent navigation drawer footer displaying the current theme
